comparisons.note: ABBA statistics use the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a statistical significance test. Fresh SQL has only unprepared query/eager lanes. Binding ratios are separate single-process measurements.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.

notes: The original full-backtrace supervisor evidence is also preserved verbatim; its stdout was middle-truncated by the output limit. The compact self-contained probe independently reproduces both baseline failures without truncation.
